name: web-ux
description: Baseline product-quality web interface guidance. Prevents technically functional but skeletal pages.
guidelines: Establish a consistent visual hierarchy, spacing scale, typography and reusable components rather than styling every page independently.
Every primary page needs a clear purpose, primary action, navigation context and responsive behavior.
Implement empty, loading, validation, success and error states where the workflow can reach them.
Forms need labels, useful validation messages and preservation of user input after recoverable errors.
Prefer credible product layouts (cards/lists/detail shells/settings sections) over raw forms followed by database output.
Do not declare a page finished merely because it renders without an exception.
definition_of_done: Primary flows work at desktop and narrow/mobile widths.
UI components look intentionally related rather than default browser HTML.
